entries.reason: Upstream reports all published picomatch versions through latest 4.0.7 affected by GHSA-fc5q-39xc-vjpf, with no first patched version as of 2026-11-17. This is temporary risk acceptance, not a vulnerability fix: enforce --omit-dev in CI, track the advisory, and upgrade/remove this entry when a patched release is available.
